headline: GOLD SLIDES 1% AS TRUMP'S "PROJECT FREEDOM" RAISES IRAN TRUCE HOPES; Silver at $73.71/oz
snippet: Gold fell to $4,583/oz on Monday as Trump's 'Project Freedom' — a plan to escort merchant ships safely through the Strait of Hormuz — sparked hopes of easing US-Iran tensions and dented safe-haven demand. Silver dropped to $73.71/oz, down $1.99 on the day, though still up $41+ year-over-year.

headline: POWER METALLIC DRILLS 9.47% CuEq Over 17.45m at Nisk Lion Zone; Quebec Copper MRE on Track for Q3
snippet: Power Metallic Mines (TSXV: PNPN) released today's Lion Zone assays from its Nisk polymetallic project in Quebec: hole 26-094 cut 17.45m at 9.47% CuEq, with a companion hole returning 39m at 5.66% CuEq including 9.2m at 15.18% CuEq. The company is targeting a Mineral Resource Estimate in Q3 2026.

headline: KLDC DRILLS 39.35 g/t Gold Over 16.4m in Step-Out at Mirado, Ontario; Six More Holes Pending
snippet: Kirkland Lake Discoveries (TSXV: KLDC) hit 50.3m of continuous gold mineralization including 39.35 g/t Au over 16.4m — and a 1,670 g/t Au bonanza over 0.38m — in a 40m step-out hole at Mirado, 20km southeast of Kirkland Lake, Ontario. Six additional holes are pending assay, with results confirmed by Chrysos PhotonAssay.

headline: NGEx COMPLETES PHASE 4 AT LUNAHUASI: New Zone Found 300m East of Mars, 60m Below Surface
snippet: NGEx Minerals wrapped up Phase 4 drilling at Lunahuasi in San Juan, Argentina with a discovery of a new high-grade copper-gold zone 300m east of the Mars deposit — only 60m below surface and open in all directions. Phase 4 final holes returned 34m at 7.25% CuEq and 48m at 7.72% CuEq; Phase 5 adit construction is planned for Q3 2026.

headline: CHINA'S ACID BAN STARTS IN MAY: Chilean Copper Output at Risk as Sulphuric Acid Prices Surge 44%
snippet: China has halted sulphuric acid exports through end-2026, threatening roughly 20% of global copper production that relies on SX-EW processing. Combined with Grasberg's ongoing force majeure after September's fatal mudslide, analysts warn the compounding supply shock could cut global refined copper output by 1%+ in an already structurally tight market.

headline: MINING M&A HITS $21.6B IN Q1 2026 — Strongest Start Since 2023 as Gold Deals Dominate
snippet: Global mining M&A reached $21.6 billion in Q1 2026, the strongest quarterly start since 2023, with gold and silver transactions comprising 77% of deal value. The surge follows full-year 2025 M&A of $93.7 billion — the highest in 13 years — driven by energy-transition metals and critical minerals competition.

headline: ALLIED GOLD CONFIRMS ZIJIN $5.5B AFRICAN GOLD BUYOUT ON TRACK; May 29 Closing Deadline
snippet: Allied Gold confirmed its three African gold mines in Mali, Côte d'Ivoire, and Ethiopia are operating normally as final regulatory approvals advance for Zijin Gold International's C$5.5 billion all-cash buyout at C$44 per share. The contractual outside closing date is May 29, 2026.

headline: HONEY BADGER SILVER TOPS TSXV This Week at +63%; Small-Cap Silver Stocks See Rotation Bids
snippet: Honey Badger Silver (TSXV: TUF) led TSXV gainers this week with a 63% surge after closing its transformative acquisition of the Prairie Creek silver project in the Northwest Territories, adding to its eight 100%-owned Canadian silver projects. The company now claims an estimated 500Moz Ag equivalent portfolio.

headline: COT REPORT MAY 1: Gold and Silver Speculator Positioning Dissected as Metals Pull Back
snippet: GoldSeek's weekly Commitment of Traders analysis breaks down speculative and commercial positioning in gold, silver, and the US dollar index as precious metals retreat from April highs. The COT data provides a technical framework for evaluating whether the current pullback is a shakeout or the start of a deeper correction.

headline: CHINA QUIETLY TIGHTENS Rare Earth Control: 5x Fines Issued as Acid Curbs Hit Processing Economics
snippet: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology rolled out rare earth enforcement rules imposing fines up to 5x illegal gains on mining, separation, and processing violations, deepening Beijing's institutional grip on the supply chain. The week also saw North American consolidation including IPO activity and strategic acquisitions as Western producers race to build ex-China capacity.

headline: URANIUM SPOT HOLDS $86/lb: Energy Fuels Lifts Sales Outlook as Long-Term Contracts Hit $90 — 18-Year High
snippet: Energy Fuels raised its 2026 uranium sales guidance even as nuclear equities have cooled from January's spike above $101/lb spot. Long-term contract prices have climbed to $90/lb — the highest since 2008 — as utilities scramble to cover record levels of uncovered future supply requirements.

headline: NEWMONT'S $3.1B RECORD FREE CASH FLOW and $6B Buyback — What It Signals for the Gold Bull Market
snippet: Newmont posted all-time Q1 highs for free cash flow ($3.1B) and adjusted EBITDA ($5.2B), producing 1.3Moz Au while announcing a new $6B share repurchase. The Motley Fool examines whether investors should have seen the earnings beat coming — and what record senior miner margins mean for junior valuations.
